_README: Closed catalogue of regulator actions the context-brief feature is allowed to suggest.
The language model SELECTS from this list and writes a one-line rationale; it cannot
invent a new action type and cannot invent an ITU citation. Edit this file to change
the action vocabulary or the wording that appears in the dashboard.
Every itu_reference below was checked against itu.int on 2026-09-21: all four
Recommendations exist, are in force, and the titles are quoted verbatim from the
ITU-T catalogue. Approval dates are included so a reviewer can confirm them fast.
E.800 (09/2008)  Definitions of terms related to quality of service
E.802 (02/2007)  Framework and methodologies for the determination and
application of QoS parameters
E.804 (02/2014)  Quality of service aspects for popular services in mobile
networks
E.806 (06/2019)  Measurement campaigns, monitoring systems and sampling
methodologies to monitor the QoS in mobile networks
E.811 (03/2017)  Quality measurement in major events
E.860 (06/2002)  Framework of a service level agreement
One Recommendation per action, each chosen for fit rather than convenience.
If you add an action, do not reuse a reference just because it is already
here - a loose citation is easier for a reviewer to attack than no citation.
The code does NOT validate these strings — re-check any you edit, and do not add
clause or section numbers unless you have confirmed them in the published text.
A fabricated citation in front of a regulator is worse than no citation.

actions.title: Schedule targeted QoE measurement around the event window
actions.detail: Plan regulator-side measurement at this location before, during and after the identified period so any change is observed rather than inferred.
actions.itu_reference: ITU-T E.811 (03/2017) — Quality measurement in major events
actions.applies_when: Corroborated scheduled context exists in or near the forecast quarter.

actions.title: Request operator verification of the local network condition
actions.detail: Ask the operator to confirm the measured condition in this area for the period, and to state any planned optimisation or maintenance works already scheduled.
actions.itu_reference: ITU-T E.802 (02/2007) — Framework and methodologies for the determination and application of QoS parameters
actions.applies_when: Any prioritised cell where the regulator does not hold operator-side evidence.

actions.title: Request an operator event-readiness plan for the period
actions.detail: Where a capacity concern is confirmed by the operator, ask for the readiness plan covering the event window. The engineering remedy remains the operator's decision.
actions.itu_reference: ITU-T E.860 (06/2002) — Framework of a service level agreement
actions.applies_when: High band, corroborated context, and an operator response already confirms a capacity concern.

actions.title: Collect additional baseline measurement before escalation
actions.detail: Measurement support for this cell is limited. Establish a defensible baseline before any operator escalation so the comparison is sound.
actions.itu_reference: ITU-T E.806 (06/2019) — Measurement campaigns, monitoring systems and sampling methodologies to monitor the quality of service in mobile networks
actions.applies_when: Measurement support is limited, or the triage pathway is Verify first.

actions.title: Monitor consumer complaints and service reports for the period
actions.detail: Track complaint and service-report volumes for this area across the window as an independent corroborating signal alongside measurement.
actions.itu_reference: ITU-T E.800 (09/2008) — Definitions of terms related to quality of service
actions.applies_when: Any prioritised cell; particularly where scheduled context raises expected demand.

actions.title: Continue routine quarterly review
actions.detail: No corroborated scheduled context was found for this area and period. Proceed with the standard quarterly triage pathway already recommended for this cell.
actions.itu_reference: ITU-T E.804 (02/2014) — Quality of service aspects for popular services in mobile networks
